holes.note: Uphill opener; deep bunker right of the landing area, green falls off on all sides.
holes.name: Sweetgum

holes.note: Plunges downhill and doglegs left; reachable with a draw, bunkers guard the front.
holes.name: Red Clay

holes.note: Short par 4 to a tiny, raised, sloping green; bunkers at 290 punish the greedy.
holes.name: Tabletop

holes.note: Brutally long downhill par 3 to a two-tier green.
holes.name: Long Leaf

holes.note: Long, uphill, dogleg left; deep fairway bunkers at the corner.
holes.name: Magnolia Rise

holes.note: Plays well downhill to a green with a severe back-left plateau.
holes.name: Cliffside

holes.note: Narrow chute through the pines to a small green ringed by sand.
holes.name: Pine Chute

holes.note: Long uphill par 5, blind second, a mound-guarded green.
holes.name: Summit

holes.note: Downhill dogleg left; anything short of the pin rolls 40 yards back down.
holes.name: False Front

holes.note: Huge downhill dogleg left through towering pines.
holes.name: Cathedral

holes.note: Longest par 4 on the course; a pond guards the left of the green.
holes.name: Long Water

holes.note: Short but terrifying: all carry over a creek to a shallow green in swirling wind.
holes.name: Swirl

holes.note: Sharp dogleg left; creek in front of the green tempts the long hitter.
holes.name: Azalea Bend

holes.note: No bunkers at all, and the wildest green on the property.
holes.name: Rollercoaster

holes.note: Pond in front of a green that runs away from you; eagle or disaster.
holes.name: Second Chance

holes.note: Water down the entire left; the green funnels toward it.
holes.name: Mirror Pond

holes.note: Tee shot must avoid the great oak; a crowned green rejects poor approaches.
holes.name: Old Oak

holes.note: Uphill through a narrow chute; bunkers in the landing area, a severe two-tier green.
holes.name: The Climb
